title: PolicySetParams
description: Params for policy.set. The document is the MATRIX — seven effect rows — and may not name rules: a whole-document write made against a document read a minute ago deleted every standing answer a person had approved (nocx-39bly), and 'rules' present-and-empty is what a renderer serialising an empty list sends. One rule is written or forgotten at a time, through policy.setRule and policy.forgetRule.

runs.description: WHEN this write takes effect for the work already running — the same three words, with the same meanings, that policy.setRule and policy.forgetRule take. "ask" (the default) applies it when it reaches every live run and, when it does not, changes NOTHING and answers with how many it would leave behind, so moving a row has a time and the person chooses it. "future" applies it and leaves the running work alone: those runs finish under the rows they were minted with, and the next run gets the new ones. "stop" applies it and then terminalizes the runs it does not reach, through the path a person's own stop takes, with a sentence naming the rows that moved. The write always happens BEFORE the stopping: a failure can then only leave a person with less than they asked for, never with destroyed work in exchange for a change that did not land.
